title: Deduplicate the two full 40-method FirestoreGateway fakes in epic_25_story_12_sync_decomp_part1_test.dart

evidence.quote: // W6.13: fetchAuditLogEntries added to FirestoreGateway interface.

why: _RecordingGateway (lines 242-467) and _PagingGateway (lines 475-697) each hand-implement all 40 FirestoreGateway methods with near-identical no-op bodies. The file's own retrofit comments ('W6.13: fetchAuditLogEntries added...', 'T1.gateway — parent-scoped child reads (stub)') appear in both classes, proving every past interface addition already had to be pasted into both by hand; the identical pattern repeats in 20+ other test files repo-wide (test/sync/*, test/core/sync/*), so the next FirestoreGateway method is N-way shotgun surgery, and a forgotten override silently returns a stale default in one fake but not the other.
recommendation: Extract a shared `NoOpFirestoreGateway` base (all 40 methods returning empty/no-op defaults) into test/helpers/ or test/mocks/; have _RecordingGateway/_PagingGateway extend it and override only the handful of methods each test actually exercises.
acceptance_criteria: _RecordingGateway and _PagingGateway shrink to only their overridden methods plus the shared base
adding a new FirestoreGateway method requires editing the shared base once, not every fake in this file
